caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object composed of several distinct parts, primarily in shades of brown. On the left side, there is a rounded, cylindrical section with a curved edge, reinforced with brass-colored rivets. This section transitions into a rectangular, open compartment. Connected to this portion is a long, narrow wooden beam extending horizontally across the center of the image. At the far right end, the beam attaches to a flat, rectangular piece of wood set perpendicular to the beam, and this segment has two metal wire loops or hooks protruding upward. Below this terminal section is a flat, leaf-shaped blade oriented vertically downward. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional features, and the artist's signature appears beneath the object toward the lower center.
title: Parlor Stereoscope
